why: Company invitation: the Q3 2026 report is published at about 07:00 CEST on 2026-10-15 (01:00 ET), with a webcast at 09:00 CEST. The baseline's 7-day 'cadence' is weekly 6-Ks, not earnings.
session_evidence: Report at ~07:00 CEST = 01:00 ET on 2026-10-15, before the US open: https://www.ericsson.com/en/press-releases/2026/10/invitation-to-media-and-analyst-briefing-for-ericsson-q3-2026-report
where_to_look: First report under new CEO Per Narvinger (handover 2026-09-30, per https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/company--news/ericsson-posts-softer-q2-sales,-shares-fall). Look for kitchen-sink signals in Swedish-language press (Dagens Industri, Affarsvarlden) and any restructuring or notice of staff cuts filed with Arbetsformedlingen.

Operator capex read-through: AT&T (the Open RAN contract), Verizon and T-Mobile Q3 capex commentary, plus India operator rollout volumes. Q2 flagged higher Q3 rollout volumes, which pressure Networks gross margin.
Component-cost inflation (memory/semis pricing) that management said builds over the coming quarters
The 6-K filed 2026-10-13 (the baseline shows +3.63% that day). Read what it was before treating it as noise.
already_in_the_wire: Q2: sales SEK 52.7bn missed, adj EBITA margin 13.1%, FCF SEK 0.4bn, shares about -8% (https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/company--news/ericsson-posts-softer-q2-sales,-shares-fall)
Q3 Networks gross margin pressure flagged in advance; adj gross margin guided at 48-50%
trades_on: Reported-quarter sales plus margin outlook. Q2 fell about 8% on a sales miss and cost-inflation flag (https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/company--news/ericsson-posts-softer-q2-sales,-shares-fall).
